metadata.description: tq-forge — autonomous skill + agent factory for Claude Code.

plugins.name: tq-forge
plugins.description: Forge, score, improve, and promote Claude Code skills and agents from one-line intents. 13 slash commands.

skills.name: tq-forge
skills.description: Scaffold a new skill or agent from a plain-language intent

skills.name: tq-forge-skill
skills.description: Force-skill mode — scaffold a single SKILL.md

skills.name: tq-forge-promote
skills.description: Move a sandbox skill or agent into production

skills.name: tq-forge-improve
skills.description: Rewrite only the weak sections of one artifact

skills.name: tq-forge-test
skills.description: Re-score an artifact without rewriting it

skills.name: tq-forge-list
skills.description: List all forged skills and agents with scores

skills.name: tq-forge-agents
skills.description: List forged agents with kind, hand-off wiring, and scores

skills.name: tq-forge-status
skills.description: Show forge state, queue, and halt status

skills.name: tq-forge-scan
skills.description: Scan installed skills and detect coverage gaps

skills.name: tq-forge-queue
skills.description: View and manage the deferred forge-work queue

skills.name: tq-forge-resume
skills.description: Resume after a pause and drain the queue
